name: Microgrid wind curtailment command interface
summary: Transfers the permitted wind-plant power restraint to its assigned resource controller.
description: Transfers the permitted wind-plant power restraint to its assigned resource controller. Renewable-generation coordination connects variable resource availability, inverter operating limits and the microgrid power target. Available solar or wind power, an issued curtailment request and actual delivered power are different signals.

In a microgrid with solar generation, the controller can restrain inverter output when local load and storage cannot absorb the available power. The resource controller reports its own availability and accepted operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Wind dispatch target” at the input and “Wind power-limit command” at the output. Plant controller response must be verified.
